sources.beginner: NextGen WorksheetExplorer (panels/lopa/WorksheetExplorer.jsx:45-63): IEF, TMEL, SIF PFDavg, enabling conditions, modifiers and IPLs (with independence flags) are all typed; tiles print frequencies and PFDavg with twelve() and RRF with six() (panelBits.jsx:8-9), the precisions the prompt asks. Each is also a product/quotient hand-calc taught in beginner.
sources.intermediate: NextGen SifExplorer: subsystem mode (SifExplorer.jsx:26-42, SubsystemFields panelBits.jsx:87-101 with architecture, rates, T1, MTTR, MRT, beta, betaD) prints PFDavg twelve(); the three-subsystem function mode (:87-103) prints the series PFDavg and RRF six(); the row's mitigated frequency with the SIF from WorksheetExplorer (:61).
sources.advanced: NextGen ProofTestExplorer (panels/lopa/ProofTestExplorer.jsx:67-78, :108-116): typed subsystem plus target PFDavg returns the longest T1 six() and the floor PFDavg twelve(); the list-of-intervals mode prints PFDavg per interval; the stretched function RRF from SifExplorer function mode (:99-100).
